Chapter 492: Chapter 2: Ranking Of Human Civilization Evolution Paths (Subscribe Please)

Chapter 492: Chapter 2: Ranking of Human Civilization Evolution Paths (Subscribe Please)

Five Eighth Rank Invincibles were very patient.

Their target was not merely to kill the avatar of the Galaxy Master.

Instead, they aimed for the Galaxy Master to fall completely, so that not even the ‘resurrection’ of a Supreme Being could save him.

If it were only about killing an avatar, they could have made their move more than a decade ago when they sneaked outside the Milky Way Main Star.

Five Eighth Rank Invincibles, by sealing the space simultaneously, would ensure the Galaxy Master, even if capable of spatial transposition, would be trapped within the planet.

At that time, their joint attack on the Milky Way Main Star would overwhelm even a B-grade modified Planetary Defense System, which would last only a few breaths at most.

...

The Galaxy Master would have no escape, neither to heaven nor earth.

For the Five Eighth Rank Invincibles, assassinating the Galaxy Master, who only had the combat power of an Eighth Stage peak, was utterly overkill, and if it were not for the regard of the Insect Race Honored Envoy, figures like Dark Scale Race Sarath among the Invincible Eighth Rank would hardly deign to cooperate.

No matter how talented the Galaxy Master was, he was merely newly advanced to the Eighth Rank. What could peak combat power at that stage do?

For those who possessed some form of Cosmic Force among the Eighth Rank Invincibles, an Eighth Stage peak was just a slightly larger ant, hardly different from those newly advanced to the Eighth Rank.

Although this ant could potentially grow into a giant in the future, it was merely an ant for now.

“After killing that Galaxy Master, we should avoid appearing on the battlefield as much as possible to dodge attention. The retaliation from Human Civilization is not easy to withstand,”

Dark Scale Race Sarath spoke softly to the other four Eighth Rank Invincibles.

Over the past decade, besides monitoring the movements of the Milky Way Main Star, they also occasionally communicated with each other and established some rapport.

“Naturally,”

“Those madmen of Human Civilization, after we’ve completely killed their unparalleled genius, even if we haven’t openly declared hostilities, they will definitely seek to covertly retaliate,”

another one of the Eighth Rank Invincibles immediately said.

Normally, among the Alliances of the Main World’s Peak Clans, conflicts were by default limited to below the Ninth Rank.

Apart from the Large Alien Battlefields allowing the presence of forces of and beyond the Ninth Rank, in other places, even in Medium-Sized Otherworldly Battlefields, traces of Ninth Rank beings were almost nonexistent.

This was an unspoken rule among the Peak Clans to keep the intensity of the wars at a manageable level.

If this rule did not exist, the struggles among the Clan Alliances would become disastrously chaotic, even involving frequent interventions by Supreme Beings.

This would be disastrous for all the major Peak Clans.

Of course, unspoken rules are just that, unspoken. Even though the five Eighth Rank Invincible Different Species did not break this rule, once they truly succeeded in completely killing the Galaxy Master,

Human Civilization would be furious.

Specifically, this would manifest in targeting them intentionally on the Different Species Battlefields, or even escalating the war against the Insect Race.

The hostile murderous intents from the Human Civilization Alliance, which even the Insect Race from another Peak Clan could resist, meant that the clans behind these five Eighth Rank Invincibles would inevitably suffer heavy losses, even risking extinction.

Ten thousand years ago, when a disciple of the Chikun Star Lord died, the Chikun Star Lord called on his friends, and several dozen Eighth Rank Invincibles descended simultaneously on several Medium-Sized Otherworldly Battlefields, nearly tearing those battlefields apart.

The Chikun Star Lord’s disciple, although highly talented, did not compare to the Galaxy Master. Even so, that situation had caused such a significant impact.

One could imagine what calamity the Human Civilization Alliance would cause once the Galaxy Master truly died.

Of course, the Insect Race made many promises to these five Eighth Rank Invincibles, guaranteeing that their clans would not be affected, and the rewards they would receive upon success would be worth their gamble.

…

Virtual World.

In a Mysterious Space, nine grand thrones stood tall.

Suddenly, three of the grand thrones solidified into formidable figures.

One of those towering figures was Xia Qin, a Supreme Being.

“Goddess of Wisdom,” Xia Qin Supreme Being glanced, “and also Goddess of Freedom, Goddess of Justice.”

The three goddesses, the ultimate intelligence of Human Civilization, had status equal to the nine Supreme Beings.

“Xia Qin Supreme Being, Feather Butterfly Supreme Being, and Ancient Power Supreme Being…” the solemn and serene voice of the Goddess of Wisdom echoed through the Mysterious Space.

Nine Supreme Beings existed in Human Civilization, but they each presided over a region, each occupied with their own tasks. Generally, when the three goddesses contacted the Supreme Beings, having two or three of them respond was usually sufficient.

“Our Human Civilization will soon have another Eighth Layer Evolution Path confirmed by you,” continued the Goddess of Wisdom.

“Oh?”

“Another entirely new Eighth Layer Evolution Path has emerged?” Xia Qin Supreme Being raised an eyebrow.

To birth an Eighth Layer Evolution Path, unlike producing an Eighth Stage Evolver, falls entirely under a different concept.

The latter has yet to catch the eyes of a Supreme Being, but the former… An Eighth Layer Evolution Path signifies a renewable source capable of continuously cultivating Eighth Stage Evolvers.

So significant that it could be considered a foundational element of a clan.

Especially one that brings the three Goddesses together and specifically notifies the Supreme Beings, it must be highly exceptional and possibly promising further advancement.

“Let me see.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being received the Eighth Stage Martial Tao Part transmitted by the Goddess of Wisdom.

“Is it that young one?” Xia Qin Supreme Being slightly stunned, he had a rather favorable impression of Lin Yuan whom he had met once personally, even bestowing such treasures as the Soul-Setting Pearl.

In the eyes of Xia Qin Supreme Being, not only had Lin Yuan stepped into the Eighth Rank before the age of one hundred, but he had also established Martial Tao, a path of evolution with immense potential.
